args.title: Document field limits in the Reports API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The Reports section documents the shape of POST /reports and schedule but omits the field limits enforced in src/api/reports.ts: name is at most 120 characters, categories is at most 50 entries (60 characters each), and schedule.recipients is 1-20 email addresses. Add these limits to the Reports section so clients can validate before sending.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The Reports section of the API reference documents the request shape but not the field limits. Looking at src/api/reports.ts, the enforced limits are: name up to 120 characters, categories up to 50 entries (60 characters each), and schedule.recipients between 1 and 20 email addresses. Opened a PR to add these to the Reports section.
